Elf_Commoner
Mango is an elven member of The Guild.
“
Guildhall is not what it was. No gambling. No blood-games. Not even a pissy little peacock fight. BORED!
„
— Mango

Involvement

Mango can be found leaning against a wall in the Guildhall within the Undercity. she is typically bored, and comments on various events happening within the Guildhall but does not take part in any combat.
